description: This Java class implements the ProductPriceService interface, managing ProductPrice entities including adding descriptions, saving or updating prices, and deleting prices, within a Spring-based application.

classes.name: ProductPriceServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductPriceService managing ProductPrice entities with add, save/update, and delete operations.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a ProductPrice entity and updates it in the database.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new ProductPrice or updates an existing one, handling associated descriptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a ProductPrice entity from the database, retrieving it if necessary to avoid detached entity errors.
